title: Relative Cohomology and Deformations of Logarithmic Foliations on Complex Spaces
summary: We study relative cohomology for logarithmic differential forms and meromorphic forms that are relatively closed with respect to the associated logarithmic foliation. Under suitable Diophantine, geometric, and topological hypotheses, we obtain decompositions into a meromorphic multiple of the defining logarithmic form, an exact meromorphic form, and a logarithmic form with constant residues.
